summary: Check out these beautiful images of our Silo Nuecrete Basin making the perfect centrepiece in Eva's Restaurant at The Pullman, Melbourne
title: Stunning Commercial Fitout Of Eva's Restaurant At The Pullman, Melbourne
bodyHtml:
Eva’s located in the heart of Melbourne CBD in the newly rebranded Pullman Hotel part of the Accor chain of hotels. By Foster undertook the refurbishment of the hotel restaurant, lounge & bar. The transformation of the bar was to reignite the use of space, creating a gathering place for hotel guests and creating a fresh new venue for new patrons.

Our Silo Nuecrete concrete basin in Rose Quartz Pink takes centre stage in the exquisitely designed bathrooms, boasting gorgeous textures of playful pink terrazzo, brass and deep greens. Please note that our Nuecrete range was a limited release product and is no longer available. Check out the gorgeous fitout below:
